rows.note: This is the neutral, all-purpose choice for saying that something may be true or may happen.

example.jyutping: ho2 nang4 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this for a casual, speaker-uncertain “maybe,” rather than the neutral 可能.

example.english: He could possibly come tonight, you never know.
example.jyutping: waa6 m4 ding6 keoi5 gam1 maan5 wui5 lai4

rows.note: Use this when focusing on whether an action is feasible or has a chance of succeeding.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 ho2 nang4 sing4 gung1
